name: GATEWAY_ACCOUNT_DELETION_GRACE_DAYS
description: is the self-service deletion grace window (GDPR Art 17): the number of days a PENDING_DELETION account is retained before the sweeper hard-deletes it.

name: GATEWAY_ADMIN_API_SECRET
description: is the shared secret that authenticates the control-plane admin RPCs (AdminCreateProject and friends), which a PLATFORM operator uses to provision projects/tenants out-of-band.

name: GATEWAY_AGEGATE_ADULT_AGE
description: is the age at or above which a user is an adult; between it and AgeGateChildMaxAge a user is a TEEN minor.

name: GATEWAY_AGEGATE_CHILD_MAX_AGE
description: is the inclusive upper age of the protected CHILD band.

name: GATEWAY_AGEGATE_ENABLED
description: is the global on/off for age-gating.

name: GATEWAY_AGEGATE_REQUIRE_DOB
description: rejects a signup that omits a date of birth (INVALID_ARGUMENT) instead of treating it as adult.

name: GATEWAY_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
description: is the comma-separated list of CORS allowed origins.

name: GATEWAY_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED
description: turns anonymous sign-in on for the DEFAULT project ( ).

name: GATEWAY_ANONYMOUS_REQUIRE_ASSURANCE
description: makes SignInAnonymously require a valid assurance token, exactly like the six enforce flags on the identified auth endpoints.

name: GATEWAY_ANONYMOUS_RETENTION_DAYS
description: bounds how long an anonymous user is kept after its LAST ACTIVITY; when left unset it is raised automatically to outlive the refresh-token lifetime, and the adjustment is logged once at boot as anonymous_retention_raised.

name: GATEWAY_APP_BASE_URL
description: Public app URLs used in email links.

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_ALLOW_PROJECT_ONLY
description: permits booting with assurance enabled and NO env-configured arm, for deployments where every app identity lives in per-project config_json.

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_ANDROID_CERT_SHA256_DIGESTS
description: is the comma-separated allowlist of the app's signing-certificate SHA-256 digests (unpadded base64url, as Play reports them).

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_ANDROID_PACKAGE_NAME
description: is the DEFAULT project's Play Integrity Android package name (per-project apps configure theirs in config_json `assurance.android`).

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_ANDROID_SA_KEY_JSON
description: is the Google service-account key (inline JSON) used to decode Play Integrity verdicts server-side.

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_CHALLENGE_TTL_SECONDS
description: bounds how long an issued attestation challenge stays redeemable.

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_DEVICE_RETENTION_DAYS
description: bounds how long an attested device row is kept after its LAST USE.

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_ENABLED
description: Client assurance (App Attest / Play Integrity / web captcha exchange).

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_ENFORCE_EMAIL_LOGIN_CODE
description: requires an assurance token on the RequestEmailLoginCode endpoint.

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_ENFORCE_MAGIC_LINK
description: requires an assurance token on the RequestMagicLink endpoint.

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_ENFORCE_PASSKEY_SIGNUP
description: requires an assurance token on the BeginPasskeySignup endpoint.

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_ENFORCE_PASSWORD_LOGIN
description: requires an assurance token on the PasswordLogin endpoint.

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_ENFORCE_PASSWORD_RESET
description: requires an assurance token on the RequestPasswordReset endpoint.

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_ENFORCE_PASSWORD_SIGNUP
description: requires an assurance token on the PasswordSignup endpoint.

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_IOS_BUNDLE_ID
description: is the DEFAULT project's App Attest bundle id; set together with AssuranceIOSTeamID (TeamID.BundleID forms the App ID).

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_IOS_ENV
description: selects the App Attest environment for the default project: "production" or "development".

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_IOS_TEAM_ID
description: is the DEFAULT project's Apple Developer team id for App Attest (per-project apps configure theirs in config_json `assurance.ios`).

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_RECAPTCHA_SCORE_THRESHOLD
description: is the reCAPTCHA v3 score below which a response is rejected; must be in [0,1].

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_RECAPTCHA_SECRET
description: is the reCAPTCHA v3 secret key (provider "recaptcha_v3").

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS
description: is the minted assurance token's lifetime.

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_TURNSTILE_SECRET
description: is the Cloudflare Turnstile secret key (provider "turnstile").

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY
description: is the Cloudflare Turnstile PUBLIC site key (provider "turnstile").

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_WEB_PROVIDER
description: selects the pkg/assurance web implementation — "turnstile" or "recaptcha_v3"; the matching secret must be set.

name: GATEWAY_ASSURANCE_WEB_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS
description: is the assurance-token lifetime for the WEB arm specifically.

name: GATEWAY_AUDIT_QUEUE_SIZE
description: Audit log queue depth for the async flusher.

name: GATEWAY_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS
description: is the audit-log retention window in days: on each tick the background sweeper deletes audit events whose occurred-at instant is older than now - AuditRetentionDays, so the service stops holding audit/security logs (which record IP address and user-agent) indefinitely (GDPR Art 5(1)(e) storage limitation).

name: GATEWAY_AUTH_ALLOW_LOCAL
description: enables local username/password auth; set false to require OAuth (intended for development).

name: GATEWAY_AUTH_REQUIRE_VERIFIED_EMAIL
description: blocks authentication until the account's email is verified.

name: GATEWAY_CONNECT_PORT
description: is the Connect-RPC HTTP listener port — the main public RPC surface.

name: GATEWAY_DEFAULT_EMAIL_DOMAIN
description: is the default email domain applied to new accounts.

name: GATEWAY_DEFAULT_PRODUCT
description: is the product slug attributed to a request that sends no X-Product header — a client that predates the header.

name: GATEWAY_DEFAULT_PROJECT_ACCESS_MODE
description: is the authentication access mode for the env-configured default project, which has no config_json to carry an `access` block: one of "open", "allowlist", "invite", or "closed" (see service.AccessMode*).

name: GATEWAY_DEFAULT_PROJECT_ALLOWED_DOMAINS
description: is the comma-separated email-domain allowlist applied to the default project when DefaultProjectAccessMode is "allowlist" (ignored for open/invite/closed).

name: GATEWAY_DEFAULT_PROJECT_ALLOWED_EMAILS
description: is the comma-separated email allowlist applied to the default project when DefaultProjectAccessMode is "allowlist" (ignored for open/invite/closed).

name: GATEWAY_DEFAULT_PROJECT_AUTH_DOMAINS
description: is a comma-separated list of serving hostnames seeded onto the default project at boot (postgres driver), so the Host→project resolver maps these branded hostnames to the default project.

name: GATEWAY_DEFAULT_PROJECT_ID
description: is the id of the control-plane Project the service seeds on boot (postgres driver) and pins zero-config requests to.

name: GATEWAY_DEFAULT_TENANT_ID
description: is the storage-scope (shard) id the default project maps onto — the data-plane tenant zero-config requests are pinned to; distinct from DefaultProjectID.

name: GATEWAY_DISABLE_FIRST_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP
description: closes the CreateFirstPlatformAdmin RPC — the trust-on-first-use bootstrap of the first platform admin — entirely.

name: GATEWAY_EMAIL_BRAND_FROM
description: is the From address for transactional mail (falls back to SMTPFrom).

name: GATEWAY_EMAIL_BRAND_FROM_NAME
description: is the From display name (rendered as "Name" <addr>).

name: GATEWAY_EMAIL_BRAND_LOGO_URL
description: is the absolute https logo URL shown in HTML email.

name: GATEWAY_EMAIL_BRAND_PRIMARY_COLOR
description: is the CSS colour used to tint branded HTML email.

name: GATEWAY_EMAIL_BRAND_PRODUCT_NAME
description: is the product name shown in email bodies.

name: GATEWAY_EMAIL_BRAND_SUPPORT_EMAIL
description: is the support address shown in footers and set as the Reply-To header.

name: GATEWAY_EMAIL_LIST_UNSUBSCRIBE
description: is the List-Unsubscribe header value applied to configured mail (e.g. "<mailto:unsubscribe@example.com>").

name: GATEWAY_EMAIL_SEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS
description: Per-recipient cooldown between transactional email sends.

name: GATEWAY_EMAIL_SERVICE_HOST
description: is the host of the internal email-sending gRPC service.

name: GATEWAY_EMAIL_SERVICE_PORT
description: is the port of the internal email-sending gRPC service.

name: GATEWAY_EMAIL_TOKEN_EXPIRY_SECONDS
description: How long an email-verification or password-reset token is valid for.

name: GATEWAY_EXPORT_MAX_AUDIT_EVENTS
description: caps how many of the caller's own audit events a self-service data export (GDPR Art 15) includes, newest first.

name: GATEWAY_GRPC_PORT
description: is the native gRPC listener port (reserved; currently unused).

name: GATEWAY_HTTP_MAX_BODY_BYTES
description: Maximum HTTP request body size in bytes, enforced via http.MaxBytesHandler so a slow-POST / oversize-payload attacker can't exhaust memory.

name: GATEWAY_IDV_AZURE_ENDPOINT
description: is the Azure Cognitive Services Face endpoint URL for the azure provider (e.g. https://NAME.cognitiveservices.azure.com).

name: GATEWAY_IDV_AZURE_KEY
description: is the Azure Cognitive Services API key (azure provider).

name: GATEWAY_IDV_AZURE_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS
description: is the IDV session-token lifetime in seconds.

name: GATEWAY_IDV_PROVIDER
description: selects the IDV backend — "azure", "stub", or "" (disabled; the IDV RPCs return CodeUnimplemented).

name: GATEWAY_IDV_REQUIRED
description: When true, PasswordLogin / OAuthLogin reject users without an approved identity verification.

name: GATEWAY_JWT_AUDIENCE
description: when non-empty, is stamped on minted access tokens as the "aud" claim and enforced by the verifier on every request.

name: GATEWAY_JWT_EXPIRY_SECONDS
description: is the access-token (JWT) lifetime in seconds; capped at 900 (RevocationModeTTLAccessTokenCap) under revocation mode "ttl".

name: GATEWAY_JWT_KEYS_FILE
description: is the path to the RS256 key document read by the "file" signer; empty auto-generates a throwaway dev key at startup (local dev / CI only — emits a warning log).

name: GATEWAY_JWT_KMS_AWS_REGION
description: is the AWS region for the "kms_aws" signer.

name: GATEWAY_JWT_KMS_KEYS
description: is a CSV of "kid=keyARN" entries for the "kms_aws" signer; required when GATEWAY_JWT_SIGNER=kms_aws.

name: GATEWAY_JWT_REQUIRE_AUD
description: when true, also rejects tokens that carry no "aud" claim; the false default lets a deploy roll out the mint-side change first, wait for in-flight tokens to expire, then flip to required.

name: GATEWAY_JWT_SIGNER
description: selects the JWT signing backend: "file" or "kms_aws" (AWS KMS).

name: GATEWAY_LOGIN_CHALLENGE_EXPIRY_SECONDS
description: is the window (seconds) after a password success in which the user must complete the 2FA challenge.

name: GATEWAY_LOGIN_LOCKOUT_SECONDS
description: is how long (seconds) an account stays locked after the threshold is hit.

name: GATEWAY_LOGIN_MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS
description: is the consecutive failed-login count that triggers a lockout.

name: GATEWAY_METRICS_PORT
description: is the port serving the Prometheus /metrics endpoint.

name: GATEWAY_MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID
description: is the Microsoft directory (tenant) id, or "common" for multi-tenant.

name: GATEWAY_MINOR_DATA_MINIMIZATION
description: gates COPPA-style data-minimization for accounts the age gate classifies as AGE_BAND_CHILD.

name: GATEWAY_NATIVE_OAUTH_APPLE_AUDIENCES
description: is the DEFAULT PROJECT's comma-separated allow-list of accepted Apple ID-token `aud` values for native login — the Services ID plus every native bundle id.

name: GATEWAY_NATIVE_OAUTH_ENABLED
description: is the kill-switch for NativeOAuthLogin (verifying Google/Apple/Microsoft ID tokens from mobile SDKs).

name: GATEWAY_NATIVE_OAUTH_GOOGLE_AUDIENCES
description: is the DEFAULT PROJECT's comma-separated allow-list of accepted Google ID-token `aud` values for native login — the web client id plus every per-platform (iOS/Android) OAuth client id.

name: GATEWAY_NATIVE_OAUTH_MICROSOFT_AUDIENCES
description: is the DEFAULT PROJECT's comma-separated allow-list of accepted Microsoft ID-token `aud` values for native login.

name: GATEWAY_NATIVE_OAUTH_PRODUCT_PROJECTS
description: maps a native client's product selector to an identity project id, as comma-separated product=projectID pairs (e.g. "easyloops=proj_abc,tortoise=proj_def").

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_ALLOWED_RETURN_URLS
description: is the comma-separated allowlist of app URLs the hosted OAuth flow may redirect back to (the `return_to` param of GET /oauth/start/{provider}).

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_APPLE_CLIENT_ID
description: is the Apple Service ID used as the OAuth client ID.

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_APPLE_KEY_ID
description: is the Apple private-key (Key) ID.

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY
description: is the Apple Sign in private key (PEM or base64).

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_APPLE_TEAM_ID
description: is the Apple Developer Team ID.

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID
description: is the GitHub OAuth client ID.

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET
description: is the GitHub OAuth client secret.

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_GOOGLE_AUTHORIZATION_URL
description: overrides the Google OAuth authorization endpoint; empty = the real Google endpoint.

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
description: is the Google OAuth client ID.

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
description: is the Google OAuth client secret.

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_GOOGLE_DISCOVERY_URL
description: overrides the Google OIDC discovery document URL; empty = the real Google endpoint.

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_GOOGLE_ISSUER
description: overrides the expected Google OIDC token issuer; empty = the real Google issuer.

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_GOOGLE_JWKS_URL
description: overrides the Google OIDC JWKS (public keys) endpoint; empty = the real Google endpoint.

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_GOOGLE_TOKEN_URL
description: overrides the Google OAuth token endpoint; empty = the real Google endpoint.

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_GOOGLE_USERINFO_URL
description: overrides the Google OIDC userinfo endpoint; empty = the real Google endpoint.

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_HUB_SHARING
description: lets a non-default project with no OAuth provider of its own borrow the default project's env-configured providers when routing hosted OAuth through the central hub (the Firebase/Auth0 model: one provider client + one registered redirect URI serve every project).

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_MICROSOFT_ALLOWED_TENANTS
description: is the DEFAULT PROJECT's comma-separated allow-list of accepted Azure AD directory (tenant) GUIDs for Microsoft sign-in (hosted + native).

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID
description: is the Microsoft / Entra ID OAuth client ID.

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET
description: is the Microsoft / Entra ID OAuth client secret.

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_OIDC_CLIENT_ID
description: is the generic OIDC provider's OAuth client ID.

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
description: is the generic OIDC provider's OAuth client secret.

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_OIDC_DISCOVERY_URL
description: overrides the generic OIDC provider's discovery document URL; empty = derived from OIDCIssuer.

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_OIDC_ENABLED
description: turns on the generic, config-driven OIDC provider so an operator can register an arbitrary standards-compliant IdP (Okta, Auth0, Keycloak, a self-hosted issuer) without a code release.

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_OIDC_ISSUER
description: is the generic OIDC provider's issuer URL; the discovery, authorization, token, JWKS, and userinfo endpoints are resolved from <issuer>/.well-known/openid-configuration unless OIDCDiscoveryURL is set.

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_OIDC_PROVIDER_KEY
description: is the registry key the generic OIDC provider is registered under and reported as Identity.Provider (e.g. "okta").

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_OIDC_SCOPES
description: overrides the space-separated OAuth scopes requested from the generic OIDC provider; empty = "openid email profile" ("openid" is always ensured).

name: GATEWAY_OAUTH_PROMPT
description: is the OAuth `prompt` parameter forwarded to providers that support it (Google, Microsoft) on the hosted authorization request.

name: GATEWAY_OTEL_DEPLOYMENT_ENV
description: sets the deployment.environment.name resource attribute.

name: GATEWAY_OTEL_ENABLED
description: turns on OTLP trace export.

name: GATEWAY_OTEL_EXPORTER_ENDPOINT
description: is the OTLP collector host:port; required when OTelEnabled.

name: GATEWAY_OTEL_EXPORTER_PROTOCOL
description: is the OTLP transport — "grpc" or "http".

name: GATEWAY_OTEL_SAMPLE_RATIO
description: is the trace head-sampling ratio in [0.0, 1.0].

name: GATEWAY_OTEL_SERVICE_VERSION
description: overrides the build version baked into the binary on emitted traces.

name: GATEWAY_PASSKEY_CHALLENGE_EXPIRY_SECONDS
description: is the lifetime in seconds of registration / login challenges.

name: GATEWAY_PASSKEY_ORIGIN
description: is the allowed origin for passkey ceremonies (scheme + host + port).

name: GATEWAY_PASSKEY_RP_ID
description: is the WebAuthn relying-party ID — must match the registrable domain (e.g. example.com).

name: GATEWAY_PASSKEY_RP_NAME
description: is the human-readable WebAuthn relying-party name.

name: GATEWAY_PASSKEY_SIGNUP_ENABLED
description: gates passkey-first signup (the unauthenticated BeginPasskeySignup / CompletePasskeySignup pair that creates a brand-new account from a passkey); set false to disable it while leaving authenticated add-a-passkey registration untouched.

name: GATEWAY_PASSWORDLESS_CODE_MAX_ATTEMPTS
description: is the max verify attempts per OTP before it is invalidated (brute-force cap).

name: GATEWAY_PASSWORDLESS_CODE_TTL_SECONDS
description: is the one-time-code lifetime in seconds (code length is fixed at 6 digits).

name: GATEWAY_PASSWORDLESS_MAGIC_LINK_TTL_SECONDS
description: is the magic-link token lifetime in seconds.

name: GATEWAY_PASSWORDLESS_SIGNUP_ENABLED
description: gates auto-create on a passwordless verify for an unknown email: when false the unknown email gets the same anti-enumeration decoy as a known one, so the endpoint never reveals which addresses exist.

name: GATEWAY_PASSWORD_RESET_ENABLED
description: gates RequestPasswordReset; when false the RPC stays enumeration-safe but is a no-op (admin resets still work).

name: GATEWAY_PASSWORD_RESET_EXPIRY_SECONDS
description: is the recovery-email reset-link lifetime in seconds.

name: GATEWAY_PASSWORD_SIGNUP_ENABLED
description: gates self-serve PasswordSignup; set false to disable it (admin-driven invitations still work).

name: GATEWAY_PHONE_CODE_COOLDOWN_SECONDS
description: is the per-request cooldown (seconds) between phone-verification sends.

name: GATEWAY_PHONE_CODE_MAX_ATTEMPTS
description: is the max wrong-code guesses before the OTP is invalidated.

name: GATEWAY_PHONE_CODE_TTL_SECONDS
description: is the phone-verification OTP lifetime in seconds.

name: GATEWAY_POSTGRES_AUTO_MIGRATE
description: runs pending migrations on connect; leave false in production and run migrations out-of-band (a rolling deploy can race replicas).

name: GATEWAY_POSTGRES_CONN_TIMEOUT_MS
description: is the per-acquire connection timeout in milliseconds, applied when checking a connection out of the pgx pool (pgxpool ConnectTimeout).

name: GATEWAY_POSTGRES_DSN
description: is the Postgres connection string (e.g. "postgres://user:pass@host:5432/identity?sslmode=disable"); required when RepoDriver is "postgres" (the default).

name: GATEWAY_POSTGRES_MAX_CONNS
description: is the connection-pool size.

name: GATEWAY_PROJECT_RESOLUTION_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES
description: bounds the number of distinct resolution keys (credential ids + hostnames) held in the cache, evicting the least-recently-used entry past the bound so the cache cannot grow unbounded under hostile or high-cardinality traffic.

name: GATEWAY_PROJECT_RESOLUTION_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
description: bounds how long a per-request project resolution (credential-key→project and Host→project) may be served from the in-process cache before being re-read from the control-plane store.

name: GATEWAY_PROJECT_SECRETS_KEY
description: is the base64-encoded 32-byte AES-256 key that encrypts per-project secrets at rest — currently the hosted-flow OAuth provider secrets (client secrets, Apple private keys) stored in a project's config_json.

name: GATEWAY_PUBLIC_EMAIL_DOMAINS
description: extends the built-in set of consumer/public email providers (gmail, outlook, yahoo, …) used by IsPublicEmailDomain.

name: GATEWAY_QR_LOGIN_BASE_URL
description: is the base URL embedded in the cross-device login QR code.

name: GATEWAY_QR_LOGIN_EXPIRY_SECONDS
description: is the QR login-session lifetime in seconds.

name: GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT_ASSURANCE_PER_IP
description: is the per-IP request cap per window on the client-assurance endpoints.

name: GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT_BOOTSTRAP_PER_IP
description: is the per-IP cap per window on CreateFirstPlatformAdmin.

name: GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT_IDV_PER_IP
description: is the per-IP cap per window on BeginIdentityVerification, where every admitted call opens a paid provider session.

name: GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT_LOGIN_PER_IP
description: is the per-IP request cap per window on the login endpoints.

name: GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT_PASSWORDLESS_PER_IP
description: is the per-IP cap per window on RequestEmailLoginCode + RequestMagicLink.

name: GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT_PHONE_PER_IP
description: is the per-IP cap per window on RequestPhoneVerification.

name: GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT_RESET_PER_IP
description: is the per-IP request cap per window on RequestPasswordReset.

name: GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT_SIGNUP_PER_IP
description: is the per-IP request cap per window on PasswordSignup.

name: GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT_VERIFY_PER_IP
description: is the per-IP request cap per window on the verification endpoints.

name: GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS
description: is the sliding window length (seconds) for the per-IP limiter.

name: GATEWAY_REFRESH_EXPIRY_SECONDS
description: is the refresh-token lifetime in seconds.

name: GATEWAY_REPO_DRIVER
description: selects the persistence driver — which Repository / DB implementation the binary wires up: "postgres", "sqlite" (embedded single-node), or "memory" (in-process, for local dev and tests).

name: GATEWAY_REQUIRE_VERIFIED_AUTH_DOMAIN
description: governs whether an UNVERIFIED custom auth-domain marked is_primary may become a project's primary auth-domain — the host that drives branded link URLs (magic links, invitations) and cookie domains.

name: GATEWAY_REVOCATION_MODE
description: selects how a DeleteRefreshTokensForUser propagates to in-flight access tokens — "ttl" or "session".

name: GATEWAY_SAML_ENTITY_ID
description: is the IdP entityID published in metadata (metadata URL).

name: GATEWAY_SAML_IDP_ENABLED
description: turns on the SAML 2.0 IdP surface.

name: GATEWAY_SAML_SIGNING_CERT
description: is the PEM-encoded X.509 certificate published in metadata.

name: GATEWAY_SAML_SIGNING_KEY
description: is the PEM-encoded RSA private key used to sign assertions.

name: GATEWAY_SAML_SLO_URL
description: is the optional single-logout endpoint.

name: GATEWAY_SAML_SSO_URL
description: is the HTTP-POST/Redirect single sign-on endpoint.

name: GATEWAY_SCIM_BEARER_TOKEN
description: is the shared secret an external IdP presents in the Authorization: Bearer header on every SCIM request (required when SCIMEnabled).

name: GATEWAY_SCIM_ENABLED
description: gates the inbound SCIM 2.0 routes.

name: GATEWAY_SCIM_PROJECT_ID
description: is the single project whose users the SCIM endpoint provisions; every SCIM operation is scoped to this project (required when SCIMEnabled).

name: GATEWAY_SESSION_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
description: bounds how long a session-state read from the in-process cache may serve "active" before being re-read from the repository.

name: GATEWAY_SIGNUP_EMAIL_COOLDOWN_SECONDS
description: Per-email cooldown on PasswordSignup.

name: GATEWAY_SMS_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
description: is the AWS access key id for SNS (provider "sns").

name: GATEWAY_SMS_AWS_REGION
description: is the AWS region for the SNS sender (provider "sns").

name: GATEWAY_SMS_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
description: is the AWS secret access key for SNS (provider "sns").

name: GATEWAY_SMS_AWS_SENDER_ID
description: is the optional AWS SNS sender id (provider "sns").

name: GATEWAY_SMS_AZURE_CONNECTION_STRING
description: is the Azure Communication Services connection string (provider "azure").

name: GATEWAY_SMS_AZURE_FROM
description: is the Azure Communication Services sender number (provider "azure").

name: GATEWAY_SMS_ENABLED
description: turns on phone (SMS OTP) verification.

name: GATEWAY_SMS_PROVIDER
description: selects the SMS backend: "twilio", "sns", or "azure".

name: GATEWAY_SMS_TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID
description: is the Twilio Account SID (provider "twilio").

name: GATEWAY_SMS_TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN
description: is the Twilio auth token (provider "twilio").

name: GATEWAY_SMS_TWILIO_FROM
description: is the Twilio sender phone number (provider "twilio").

name: GATEWAY_SMTP_FROM
description: is the envelope/From address for outbound mail.

name: GATEWAY_SMTP_HOST
description: is the SMTP server hostname.

name: GATEWAY_SMTP_PASS
description: is the SMTP auth password.

name: GATEWAY_SMTP_PORT
description: is the SMTP server port.

name: GATEWAY_SMTP_PROVIDERS
description: is a JSON array of SMTP configs ([]email.SMTPConfig) used as a failover chain in order; overrides the single-provider SMTP_* vars.

name: GATEWAY_SMTP_TLS
description: enables STARTTLS / TLS for the SMTP connection.

name: GATEWAY_SMTP_USER
description: is the SMTP auth username.

name: GATEWAY_SQLITE_MAX_CONNS
description: is the connection-pool size for a file database.

name: GATEWAY_SQLITE_PATH
description: is the SQLite database file path, or ":memory:" for an ephemeral in-process database; required when RepoDriver is "sqlite".

name: GATEWAY_SSO_CONTINUE_MODE
description: selects what a valid SSO session buys the user: SSOContinueModeTap offers a "Continue as <email>" card that names the account before anything is minted, SSOContinueModeSilent forwards without an interstitial.

name: GATEWAY_SSO_ENABLED
description: turns on browser single sign-on at the auth origin (ADR-0014): a successful hosted authentication sets a host-locked `__Host-sso_session` cookie, and a later product asking for a session can be served from it without a second provider round trip.

name: GATEWAY_SSO_HUB_ORIGINS
description: is the comma-separated allowlist of web origins that may call GET /sso/session with credentials to render their own "Continue as" card (the sign-in hub is a separate origin from the auth API).

name: GATEWAY_SSO_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS
description: is the SSO session's ROLLING lifetime: each successful use re-anchors expiry at now + TTL, so an actively used browser stays signed in and an abandoned one lapses on schedule.

name: GATEWAY_SWEEPER_BATCH_SIZE
description: is the per-table, per-tick deletion cap.

name: GATEWAY_SWEEPER_GRACE_SECONDS
description: is extra grace past expires_at before a row is eligible for deletion (covers flows that just consumed the token).

name: GATEWAY_SWEEPER_INTERVAL_SECONDS
description: is the sweep tick interval in seconds; 0 disables sweeping entirely (for tests or deployers who run their own GC).

name: GATEWAY_TENANT_INVITATION_EXPIRY_SECONDS
description: How long a tenant-membership invitation is valid for before it must be reissued.

name: GATEWAY_TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY
description: is the base64-encoded 32-byte AES-256 key that encrypts TOTP secrets at rest. Throwaway dev key if unset; required in prod (a deterministic dev fallback must never be used in production).

name: GATEWAY_TOTP_ISSUER
description: is the issuer name shown in users' authenticator apps.

name: GATEWAY_TOTP_RECOVERY_PEPPER
description: Pepper used as the HMAC-SHA-256 key for recovery-code hashing.

name: GATEWAY_TRUSTED_PROXIES
description: Trusted proxies: comma-separated list of CIDRs whose X-Forwarded-For headers the service will honour.

name: GATEWAY_WEBHOOKS_BACKOFF_BASE_SECONDS
description: is the first-retry delay; it doubles per attempt up to the ceiling.

name: GATEWAY_WEBHOOKS_BACKOFF_MAX_SECONDS
description: is the exponential-backoff ceiling.

name: GATEWAY_WEBHOOKS_BATCH_SIZE
description: is the number of due deliveries claimed per tick.

name: GATEWAY_WEBHOOKS_ENABLED
description: is the master switch for outbound user-lifecycle eventing; when false the service emits to a no-op publisher and runs no delivery worker.

name: GATEWAY_WEBHOOKS_MAX_ATTEMPTS
description: is the per-delivery retry budget before a webhook is abandoned and surfaced via the structured logger.

name: GATEWAY_WEBHOOKS_WORKER_INTERVAL_SECONDS
description: is the outbox drain tick interval.

name: GATEWAY_WEBHOOK_SUBSCRIPTIONS
description: is the raw JSON array declaring the outbound-webhook endpoints seeded into the outbox at boot.
